> :mega: *Three days left to apply: <http://www.longitudepolicy.org|Longitude DC Intensive>, deadline Sunday, Aug 16*
> A fully funded, eight-day AI policy program in Washington, DC, for people with a technical AI safety background who want to find out where their expertise is needed in US policy.
> 
> *Why should you apply?*
> • No policy experience needed – the program is built for people with a technical AI safety background.
> • Travel, housing, and meals are covered.
> • Program features a variety of speakers to explore the whole breadth of AI policy-related work *beyond AI policy research*
> • Multiple AI policy orgs have expressed hiring needs for technical talent and are interested in sourcing candidates from the cohort
> 
> _October 5 to 14, 2026, Washington, DC_
> 
>  *<https://longitude.fillout.com/apply?ref=far|Apply here by August 16>*
>  Know someone who should be there? <https://longitude.fillout.com/refer|Refer them here>.

Applications to <https://www.matsprogram.org/apply|Neel Nanda's Winter 2027> <https://www.matsprogram.org/apply|stream> are open! Tell your friends :mats-flame:

*We're accepting applications for the fifth iteration of the AI Security Bootcamp!*

<https://aisb.dev|AI Security Bootcamp> is a fully funded program for senior security professionals shaping how we secure frontier AI systems.

AISB is a 7-day intensive focused on the risks as frontier AI systems become more capable and are targeted by sophisticated attacks. The program covers threat modeling, adversarial attacks, LLM security, infrastructure controls, weight security, formal verification, data center security, AI control, and hardware governance.

We are looking for senior security professionals with 5+ years of experience. No AI or ML background required. Past participants have been affiliated with OpenAI, Anthropic, Nvidia, Google, Meta, Apple, Microsoft, AWS, Stanford, MIT, Oxford, Cambridge, and national security agencies.

Applications close 16th Aug. We review on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as early as possible.

<https://airtable.com/appyq1bBRnK6s7AkM/paglvXzxYAiJclCZX/form|Apply here>, or learn more at <https://aisb.dev/sf26|aisb.dev/sf26>

If you know someone who might be a strong candidate, please share this with them, or send them the <https://www.linkedin.com/posts/ai-security-bootcamp_want-to-learn-why-anthropic-cannot-secure-activity-7477334551665475584-G68W?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAAC90MxIBYeuJ2u9HmNlVyNUYtS8Tpjufl2U|linkedin post>.
